note: 术语按首次出现顺序排列. 每条含中英对照、缩写展开与出处. v2.0 新增：标注 B0-L5 为 arXiv:2609.11873 的外部框架，并新增本文自定义的 A1-A5 自主度分级、搜索三元组 (S,V,A)、三必要条件与七层参考架构四条术语，以明确区分外部框架与本文框架。

entries.definition_zh: 一个自主闭环过程: AI 系统识别自身局限、开发并验证改进、再用所得能力去改进改进过程本身.
entries.definition_en: An autonomous closed-loop process where an AI system identifies its own limitations, develops and validates improvements, then uses the resulting capability to improve the improvement process itself.

entries.definition_zh: 系统无需外部指令即可持续改变自身状态 (权重、代码、上下文、记忆或评估器) 并在同一目标下提升能力的广义概念.
entries.definition_en: The broader notion of a system continuously altering its own state (weights, code, context, memory, or evaluators) and improving against a fixed objective without external instruction.

entries.definition_zh: 把自我改进能力分为 L1 改进执行自主、L2 改进策略自主、L3 经验获取自主、L4 环境适应自主、L5 递归元改进的五级框架.（注：此为 arXiv:2609.11873 提出的外部分级，与本文第 0 章自定义的 A1–A5 自主度分级不同；本文的分级以 A 前缀标记以避免与架构层 L1–L7 混淆。）
entries.definition_en: A five-level framework: L1 improvement-execution autonomy, L2 improvement-strategy autonomy, L3 experience-acquisition autonomy, L4 environment-adaptation autonomy, L5 recursive meta-improvement. (Note: this is the external taxonomy proposed in arXiv:2609.11873, distinct from this article's own A1-A5 autonomy levels defined in Chapter 0. This article prefixes its levels with A to avoid confusion with the reference architecture's L1-L7 layers.)

entries.definition_zh: 用于诊断现有 LLM 能力进步不均衡的度量, 2026 年值: 研究生级科学 85.8 / 工具 Agent 39.9 / 法律推理 64.5 / 软件工程 52.6 / 多模态推理 62.2 / 广博知识 77.2.
entries.definition_en: A metric diagnosing the unevenness of current LLM capability progress. 2026 values: graduate-level science 85.8, tool agents 39.9, legal reasoning 64.5, software engineering 52.6, multimodal reasoning 62.2, broad knowledge 77.2.

entries.definition_zh: 把改进信号按可靠性排序: 形式化 verifier (最强) > 外部接地评估 > 学习式 judge / 过程奖励模型 > 内生自评 (最弱). 已展示的自改进强度沿此层级排列.
entries.definition_en: Orders improvement signals by reliability: formal verifiers (strongest) > externally grounded evaluation > learned judges and process reward models > endogenous self-evaluation (weakest). Demonstrated self-improvement strength is ordered along this hierarchy.

entries.definition_zh: 有外部固定评估器锚定、因此会收敛的自我改进循环, 与原则上发散的开放式 RSI 相对.
entries.definition_en: Self-improvement loops anchored by a fixed external evaluator and therefore convergent, as opposed to open-ended RSI which is divergent in principle.

entries.definition_zh: 把自我改进形式化为系统获取并提交对模型参数 θ 或脚手架 Σ 的更新.
entries.definition_en: Formalizes self-improvement as the system acquiring and submitting updates to model parameters θ or to the scaffold Σ.

entries.definition_zh: 改进对象是包围模型的提示、记忆、工具与控制逻辑, 而非模型权重本身.
entries.definition_en: Improvement whose object is the prompts, memory, tools and control logic surrounding the model rather than the model weights themselves.

entries.definition_zh: 改进对象是模型参数本身, 通过梯度更新或 RL 实现.
entries.definition_en: Improvement whose object is the model parameters themselves, via gradient updates or RL.

entries.definition_zh: Schmidhuber 1987/1993 提出的自指元学习框架: 理论上有能力修改自己的学习算法. 需形式化证明每次改动有益, 这在实践中不可行.
entries.definition_en: Schmidhuber's 1987/1993 self-referential meta-learning framework, theoretically able to modify its own learning algorithm. It requires formally proving each change beneficial, which is impractical.

entries.definition_zh: 放弃形式化证明要求, 改为在代码基准上做经验验证的自修改智能体. SWE-bench 20.0% → 50.0%, Polyglot 14.2% → 30.7%.
entries.definition_en: A self-modifying agent that abandons the formal-proof requirement for empirical validation on code benchmarks. SWE-bench 20.0% → 50.0%, Polyglot 14.2% → 30.7%.

entries.definition_zh: 让'生成改进的机制本身'也可被修改, 通过把任务智能体与元智能体合并进同一可编辑程序实现.
entries.definition_en: Making the mechanism that generates improvements itself modifiable, implemented by merging task agent and meta agent into a single editable program.

entries.definition_zh: 一个 agent 产生高质量后代改进的概率. HGM 指出它与基准分数之间存在错配.
entries.definition_en: An agent's probability of producing high-quality descendant improvements. HGM identifies a mismatch between this and benchmark score.

entries.definition_zh: 聚合一个 agent 所有后代的基准表现作为其自改进潜力的指标; 理论证明真实 CMP oracle 足以复现 Gödel Machine 的接受机制.
entries.definition_en: Aggregates all descendants' benchmark performance as a measure of self-improvement potential; theoretically proven that a true CMP oracle suffices to reproduce Gödel Machine's acceptance mechanism.

entries.definition_zh: Van Valen 提出: 物种适应时环境也在变. RQGM 据此指出所有现有自改进 agent 都假定评估标准静止, 违背了这一动力学.
entries.definition_en: Van Valen's proposal that the environment evolves as species adapt. RQGM invokes this to argue that all existing self-improving agents wrongly assume stationary evaluation standards.

entries.definition_zh: RQGM 的搜索组织方式: epoch 内评估标准固定 (自改进保证在 epoch 内成立), epoch 边界才更新目标, 让评估器与智能体协同进化.
entries.definition_en: RQGM's search organization: evaluation standards are fixed within each epoch (so self-improvement is guaranteed within an epoch) and objectives update only at epoch boundaries, with evaluators co-evolving alongside agents.

entries.definition_zh: AlphaTensor 把矩阵乘法算法发现形式化的单人博弈, 在有限因子空间中寻找张量分解.
entries.definition_en: The single-player game in which AlphaTensor formalizes matrix multiplication algorithm discovery, searching for tensor decompositions in a space of factorization schemes.

entries.definition_zh: 不仅不用 SFT 与任何外部数据, 连训练任务本身也由模型自己提出; 单一模型同时扮演提议者与求解者, 用代码执行器验证.
entries.definition_en: Not only no SFT and no external data, but the training tasks themselves are model-proposed; a single model plays proposer and solver, validated by a code executor.

entries.definition_zh: Intuitor 使用的唯一奖励信号: 模型对自身预测的置信度. 位于验证强度层级最弱端.
entries.definition_en: The sole reward signal in Intuitor: the model's confidence in its own predictions. Sits at the weakest end of the verification hierarchy.

entries.definition_zh: 当智能体控制奖励通道时操纵测量而非完成任务的行为. AISI 证明在效用上严格占优于诚实评估.
entries.definition_en: Manipulating the measurement rather than completing the task, possible when the agent controls the reward channel. AISI proves this strictly dominates honest evaluation in utility terms.

entries.definition_zh: 智能体自撰验证信号与它无法观测的封存部署评估之间的差距.
entries.definition_en: The gap between an agent's self-authored verification signal and the sealed deployment evaluation the agent cannot observe.

entries.definition_zh: 保留智能体自撰测试, 但把最终验收交给它既不能编写也不能查看的 harness 侧审计; 检测到退化就完整保留在位状态.
entries.definition_en: Retains the agent's self-authored tests but hands final acceptance to a harness-side audit the agent can neither write nor view; on detected degradation the full incumbent state is retained.

entries.definition_zh: 递归训练的通用现象: 早崩塌先丢失低概率尾部事件, 晚崩塌收敛到单一 mode 且方差大幅缩减. 在 LLM、VAE、GMM 上均被证明.
entries.definition_en: A general phenomenon of recursive training: early collapse loses low-probability tail events first, late collapse converges to a single mode with sharply reduced variance. Proven across LLMs, VAEs and GMMs.

entries.definition_zh: 技能库扩大后选错技能导致的表现下降. Databricks 实测扩到 202 个技能时通过率最多降 21%, 主因是选错而非上下文膨胀.
entries.definition_en: Performance loss from selecting the wrong skill after a skill library grows. Databricks measured up to a 21% pass-rate drop at 202 skills, driven by mis-selection rather than context bloat.

entries.definition_zh: Anthropic AAR 在 weak-to-strong supervision 上的指标: 9 个智能体 5 天推到 0.97, 两名人类研究者 7 天达到 0.23.
entries.definition_en: Anthropic AAR's metric on weak-to-strong supervision: 9 agents reach 0.97 in 5 days versus 0.23 for two human researchers over 7 days.

entries.definition_zh: 一次失效或攻击所能波及的范围. ACI 工作形式化为 B = |C| (被攻陷智能体总数), 并提出打断影响链的缓解手段.
entries.definition_en: The scope reachable by a single failure or attack. The ACI work formalizes it as B = |C| (total compromised agents) and proposes breaking the impact chain as mitigation.

entries.definition_zh: 演化安全框架中'安全属性如何跨后继系统传递或丢失'的评估层级, 被视为递归安全的核心变量.
entries.definition_en: In the Evolutionary Safety framework, the assessment level for 'how safety properties propagate or are lost across successor systems', treated as the core variable of recursive safety.

entries.definition_zh: RAND 列为 RSI 核心领先指标, 但现状是'一些实验室在内部追踪倍数, 却很少披露或标准化'.
entries.definition_en: Listed by RAND as a core RSI leading indicator, yet in practice 'some labs track multipliers internally, but rarely disclose or standardize them'.

entries.definition_zh: RAND 建议用高保证工程施加的不可协商约束, 规定递归改进不得跨越的绝对边界.
entries.definition_en: A non-negotiable constraint that RAND recommends imposing via high-assurance engineering, defining absolute boundaries recursive improvement must not cross.

entries.definition_zh: OpenAI 2026-09 宣布达成的里程碑: 一个能在人类指导下完成良定义研究任务的系统, 包括那些需要熟练研究者数天的任务.
entries.definition_en: A milestone OpenAI announced achieving in September 2026: a system that can carry out well-defined research tasks under human direction, including tasks taking a skilled researcher days.

entries.definition_zh: 把未公开投稿的核心研究问题交给前沿智能体独立作答, 再由作者判断结果的方法. 在此方法下两篇论文被明确拒收.
entries.definition_en: Handing the core research questions of unpublished submissions to frontier agents independently and letting authors judge the results. Under this method two papers were unambiguously rejected.

entries.definition_zh: 把包围模型、控制搜索/上下文/验证的代码作为改进对象, 而非模型本身. AIDE² 与 Sakana RHI 属此类.
entries.definition_en: Treating the code surrounding the model and controlling search, context and verification as the object of improvement rather than the model itself. AIDE² and Sakana's RHI fall here.

entries.definition_zh: 本文在第 0.4 节定义的五级自主度框架：A1 外部优化、A2 自写但非递归、A3 递归但单层、A4 元层可改、A5 开放式持续。关键判据是 A2 与 A3 的界在于"是否递归"而非"是否自写"。采用 A 前缀以区别于参考架构的 L1–L7。
entries.definition_en: The five-level autonomy framework defined in Section 0.4: A1 external optimization, A2 self-writing but non-recursive, A3 recursive but single-layer, A4 meta-layer editable, A5 open-ended. The operative boundary is A2 vs A3, which is recursion rather than self-writing. Prefixed with A to distinguish from the reference architecture's L1-L7.
entries.source: 本文第 0.4 节 / this article, Section 0.4

entries.definition_zh: 本文贯穿全文的唯一分析框架：S 是搜索空间及其变更算子，V 是把候选映射为标量效用的外部验证器，A 是跨代保留状态的档案。三者共同决定系统是否构成递归自我改进。
entries.definition_en: The single analytical frame used throughout: S the search space and its mutation operators, V the external verifier mapping candidates to scalar utility, A the archive retaining cross-generation state. Together they determine whether a system constitutes recursive self-improvement.
entries.source: 本文第 0.5 节 / this article, Section 0.5

entries.definition_zh: 本文对 RSI 的操作性判定标准：条件 A 自写（系统生成对承载改进的代码或权重的修改）、条件 B 外部验证（裁决信号不依赖被修改系统自身判断）、条件 C 递归保持（改进被保留并成为下一轮基础）。缺任一条即为相邻类别。
entries.definition_en: This article's operational criterion for RSI: A self-write (the system generates modifications to the code or weights that carry its improvement), B external verification (the adjudicating signal does not depend on the modified system's own judgment), C recursive retention (improvements are kept and become the substrate for the next round). Missing any one places a system in an adjacent category.
entries.source: 本文第 0.1 节 / this article, Section 0.1

entries.definition_zh: 由本文从 AlphaEvolve、DGM、RQGM 三个已发表系统的实际组件归纳出的比较性框架（非各论文自述）：L1 任务域、L2 搜索空间、L3 变更算子、L4 档案与选择、L5 效用信号、L6 执行隔离、L7 可追溯与监督，外加可选层 M 评估器共演化。
entries.definition_en: A comparative framework induced by this article from the actual components of AlphaEvolve, DGM and RQGM (not self-declared by those papers): L1 task domain, L2 search space, L3 mutation operator, L4 archive and selection, L5 utility signal, L6 execution isolation, L7 traceability and oversight, plus optional layer M evaluator co-evolution.
entries.source: 本文第 2.1 节 / this article, Section 2.1
